main_reviewer: Fresh non-author to be assigned after complete drafts
blind_phase: Solve every actual learner task from student.md and its visible teaching and support. Earlier accepted learner chapters and actual thirteen-unit registers may be consulted. Initial allowlist: the current learner master, accepted earlier learner materials/registers, original primary images or scans without current editorial annotation, AGENTS.md, EDITORIAL_POLICY.md and this neutral protocol. Do not open the current coverage contract, brief, audits, proposals, source token maps, key, ordered models, complete translation witnesses or helpers exposing them. An audit filename need not say private to contain answers.
freeze_gate: Coordinator verifies every actual requested output is attempted, records learner identity, exports Beads and commits the unchanged witness locally. Only the coordinator's subsequent explicit message unlocks comparison. Elapsed time or files appearing do not unlock it.
comparison_phase: Compare every frozen solution with the separate key, actual requested output positions, target versus validity distinctions, evidence and exact assigned dependencies. Keep the initial witness immutable; record corrections and disagreements separately. Resolve all material findings and bind acceptance to final actual masters and substantive contract identity.
paradigm_reviewer: Separate fresh non-author agent: inspect all complete actual displays, diagnostics and derivations against primary evidence, accounting for each cell and the word-formation meaning/scope rules. Structural equality alone is not linguistic proof.
exclusive_files: Reviewers edit only their allocated review files; the coordinator owns contract and integration, and authors own lesson/key repairs.
known_exposure: Root, unit14_source, unit14_grammar and unit14_design have current audit or design roles and are ineligible to claim a fresh blind solve of this unit.
page_review: Every final learner/key page requires non-author visual inspection, bound to final PDF and rendered-image identities. Byte-identical reuse must identify the actual earlier inspected image; hashing alone is not inspection.
